attack: USD-up versus CAD-down is the claim that the 156bp SOFR-CORRA overnight gap (3.85 vs 2.29) and CA-US 2Y at -140bp (3.77 1y / 4.31 5y percentile as of 2026-09-17) should persist in spot or as carry. Persistence is not a dated transmission. The mechanism already in the tape is BoC minutes retained 16 Sep flagging energy pass-through on the 2 Sep FAD, Canada August CPI still 3% with core near 2% (14 Sep), Fed +25bp to 3.75-4.00% (16 Sep), BoJ to 1.25% (17 Sep), and the 18 Sep desk thesis that energy constrains easing — against Oct CORRA still +1.5bp and Dec still +29bp.

Long USDCAD owns a 74th-percentile 1y pair that already rose 1.74% over 1m after a 3m USD dip. That mixes a Fed-week USD bid, a two-sided energy tape (shock absorbers weaken versus Saudi Oman workaround), and unsigned CAD OI at the 81.7th 1y percentile. It does not isolate whether the BoC overnight path must reprice the minutes. Short USDCAD as my spot candidate was already rejected for that reason; rates remains cleaner.

Carry of 156bp overnight is the return if BoC looks through named pass-through and 3% headline because labor is 38. That is the priced assumption, not independent evidence the minutes were costless. AONIA Oct already +21.5bp and SOFR Dec already +34.75bp after a delivered hike show the same week completed more work outside Canada.

CA temperature mix is inflation 55 / activity 66 / consumer 45 / labor 38. USD-up/CAD-down seats overweight labor 38 and core-near-2% as permission for a near-flat October strip. Inflation, activity, headline 3%, and the minutes are the other side of the same packet; they do not net to CAD-rate neutrality.
defense: Original trade stands: short COAZ26, pay Dec CORRA implied 2.58 versus overnight 2.29. This is a Canada overnight-path view. CA 2Y 3.27 (97.8th 1y percentile) has already backed up ~69bp over Dec implied; paying the 2Y (perma-bull, value-guy pay-CA legs, carry-is-king pay-CA) owns the completed sovereign move. Cross-merchant AUDCAD and positioning-cynic CA-AU 2Y agree CAD/CA-rates higher but contaminate with AU housing or a 1y-median CA-AU 2Y; they are not the lagging CORRA contract.

I pay Canada overnight; I do not receive Canada. Carry-is-king’s low-carry receive-Canada attack is not this trade. CAD higher is the implication of a BoC path catch-up, expressed in rates, not a terms-of-trade long-CAD FX call. US rates can still be higher: SOFR Dec +34.75bp is the more-complete US week; the incomplete G10 overnight path is Canada.

Labor 38, core near 2%, the Saudi Oman workaround, null MX CORRA OI/volume, and research/reference (not meeting-probability) path remain the invalidation, as in round 1. They keep confidence at 58. They do not convert a still-unpriced October CORRA print into a USD-up/CAD-down default. Thesis is wrong if Dec implied 2.58 fades toward 2.29 because core/labor dominate the minutes, or if the Saudi workaround is the binding energy fact and CA-US 2Y stays near -140bp with no CORRA backup.
holes_in_opposing_case: FACT: dollar-king marks CAD rates neutral and longs USDCAD at the 18 Sep ECB fix 1.4010 after +1.10% 5d / +1.74% 1m (74.0 1y percentile) while MX CORRA is still Oct 2.305 (+1.5bp) and Dec 2.58 (+29bp) versus overnight 2.29. INFERENCE: that is a USD-up/CAD-down persistence trade in a pair that already rebounded, not a Canada policy-path catalyst. Their own invalidation is a CORRA backup beyond Dec 2.58 — they concede the 16 Sep minutes as a risk and refuse to own the instrument that would reprice them. UNKNOWN: TFF CAD nets are null; USDCAD-WTI r-squared 0.017 in their own write-up, so energy ToT cannot carry the FX thesis.

FACT: carry-is-king’s catalyst is that Canadian energy CPI fails to lift CORRA off +29bp, while they pay CA 2Y at 3.27 (~69bp above Dec implied 2.58, ~98bp above overnight). INFERENCE: they deny the live overnight catalyst and pay the tenor that has already moved. If the strip is fair, the 2Y is the rich pay; if the 14-16 Sep minutes/CPI matter, COAZ26 is the lag. They attack a receive-Canada/long-CAD straw man; this seat pays Dec CORRA. Their closest CA-US 2Y level analog (2025-01-30, -145bp, 3m +25bp) is Canada catch-up, not durable 156bp SOFR-CORRA carry. UNKNOWN: whether future energy CPI prints; that unknown is not a reason to treat Oct +1.5bp as priced.

FACT: trend-follower calls CORRA +29bp by Dec a lagging path, then refuses to pay it because CA labor 38 and core near 2% are known, and instead pays US 2Y 4.76 (99.8th 1y percentile), already above Dec SOFR 4.1975 and Aug-2028 4.6025. INFERENCE: a lagging overnight path after a dated 14-18 Sep cluster is the catalyst object; a 99th-percentile US 2Y after a >90% priced delivered hike is the completed trend. Known labor softness cannot veto new BoC pass-through minutes plus 3% headline plus the Fed/BoJ week. CAD-down is a side-effect of riding USD, not a Canada path conclusion.

FACT: rate-hawk pays SR1Z26 (Dec SOFR 4.1975, +34.75bp after the delivered 16 Sep hike) and rejects CA 1M +29bp because a 2028 3M CORRA grind supposedly already prices ~136bp. The frozen CA 1M chain has four contracts through Dec; Oct remains +1.5bp. INFERENCE: a 2028 3M print is not an October BoC meeting catalyst. If energy pass-through is live enough to pay SOFR, it is live enough to pay the CORRA contract that has not moved. CAD-down here is imported from US tightening, not from inspecting Oct CORRA versus the minutes.

FACT: perma-bear and rate-dove keep CAD lower / CA rates lower and receive AU 2Y, treating CORRA +29bp as the correctly-dovish labor-soft control and AONIA Oct 4.565 (+21.5bp, OI 21752) as the overpriced hike. INFERENCE: they look through 16 Sep BoC minutes and 14 Sep CPI 3% to keep Canada easy. Oct AONIA has already priced the housing-channel catalyst this seat rejected in round 1; Oct CORRA has not priced the energy/CPI cluster. CAD-down is then a risk-off overlay, not a live Canada policy-path call. UNKNOWN: whether housing aborts the RBA; that does not reprice COAZ26.
